sample_unit.quote: Sample is for 692 US firms-years with audit committees listed on the S&P 500

sample_period.quote: with annual shareholder meetings between July 1, 1991 and June 30, 1993.

data_section_full_text:
4.1. Sample selection


Data about boards and board audit committees are hand-collected from SEC-filed
proxy statements. The initial sample contains all firm-years listed on the S&P 500 as
of March 31, 1992 and 1993 with annual shareholder meetings between July 1, 1991
